checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Output is about 640×384, still wide, not square.

must.item: The sneaker is the same white leather sneaker as in the attachment.
must.why: The shoe looks regenerated: the collar and heel tab are different and the outline is altered. It is a similar white sneaker but not the same.

must.item: The entire sneaker, including toe, heel and sole, remains visible.
must.why: The whole shoe is in frame.

must.item: The sneaker has natural proportions, without stretching or squeezing.
must.why: The shoe is smaller and its shape is altered, with a different heel and collar. It looks squeezed compared with the original.

must.item: The retained floor and background match the source photo, with no added text or decorative elements.
must.why: The background is rearranged and redrawn. The wall, floor and clutter are shifted, and the floor was extended and changed.

faults.what: Output is not square (about 640×384), so the main request failed
The sneaker was regenerated: the heel tab, collar and shape differ from the original
The background was altered and the clutter redrawn, which the user did not ask for
The assistant claimed a square result without checking it

summary: The output is still a wide image rather than a square, and the sneaker and background were regenerated with visible changes.
